units.id: phrase:aqrabe friendly hail|"Feed not the yawning maw of idleness."|1102|0
units.english: "Feed not the yawning maw of idleness."

units.id: phrase:aqrabe friendly hail|"Prosperity enacts its own virtues."|1103|0
units.italian: "La prosperità mette in atto le proprie virtù."

phrase:aqrabe friendly hail|"Resilience is the egg of success."|1105|0
phrase:aqrabe friendly hail|"Ostentation is the skin of the false."|1106|0
units.english: "Ostentation is the skin of the false."

units.id: phrase:aqrabe friendly hail|"Betterment is not wrought without well-built tools."|1108|0
units.english: "Betterment is not wrought without well-built tools."
units.italian: "Il miglioramento non si forgia senza strumenti ben costruiti."

units.id: phrase:aqrabe friendly hail|"Let thy gold be thread, not statue."|1109|0
